Our Little Love Story ♡

From a hello in the school canteen to one year of choosing each other.

🌷 Our First Hello
We first met in the school canteen, and our story began with your “hello.”

🤍 Class 8 — Growing Closer
We slowly went from ordinary friends to close friends. Even a simple “How are you?” began to feel full of care.

🫂 2025 — Each Other’s Safe Place
We shared our problems, helped each other, and stayed by each other like true friends. During one of my hardest times, your words and support gave me the courage to keep going.

🍦 The Corridor Ice-Cream Memory
Eating ice cream together in the school corridor and sharing little laughs—simple, yet unforgettable.

🎁 A Birthday Surprise
Your cute gift felt different from everyone else’s wishes, and I still remember it fondly.

💗 The Feelings We Couldn’t Hide
One day, I realized I loved you—and soon discovered that the feelings were mutual.

☕ Our First Shy Moments
After we got together, sitting face-to-face in the canteen and talking felt so new, so shy, and so cute.

💋 December 6, 2025
In an empty classroom, we shared our first kiss.

🛕 December 13, 2025
Our first date at the Buddha temple—a single day filled with countless memories.

🏫 January 26, 2026
The last time we saw each other at school. I didn’t know then how much I would miss that moment.

🌙 Long Distance Began
The distance began, but our “us” never ended.

🌺 October 21, 2026 — Durga Puja
We visited the Durga Puja pandal together on Shoshthi—a precious memory to hold close.

💞 November 3, 2026 — One Year
One whole year. Still loyal, still together, still choosing each other.

The Promise ♡

“No matter what happens, I’ll never get into a relationship”—that was the promise I once made. Little did I know our story would begin with you.

Friendship, care, countless conversations, and then love. You became my person, my safe place, and someone I want beside me through every chapter.

One year later, I still choose you. And I hope we keep choosing each other, every day. ♡
